# signoz_route_policy (Resource)

Creates and manages route policy resources in SigNoz.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_route_policy" "critical_alerts" {
  route_name  = "critical-alerts"
  description = "Route critical alerts to PagerDuty"
  enabled     = true

  matchers {
    match_name  = "severity"
    match_value = "critical"
    match_type  = "equals"
  }

  channel_ids = ["1", "3"]

  continue_matching = false
  group_wait        = "30s"
  group_interval    = "5m"
  repeat_interval   = "4h"
}

output "route_policy" {
  value = signoz_route_policy.critical_alerts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `route_name` (String) Name of the route policy.
- `matchers` (Attributes List) List of matchers for the route policy. (see below for nested schema)
- `channel_ids` (List of String) List of notification channel IDs to route alerts to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the route policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route policy is enabled. By default, it is true.
- `continue_matching` (Boolean) Whether to continue matching subsequent route policies after this one matches. By default, it is false.
- `group_wait` (String) How long to wait before sending a notification about new alerts that are added to a group. By default, it is 30s.
- `group_interval` (String) How long to wait before sending a notification about new alerts added to an already firing group. By default, it is 5m.
- `repeat_interval` (String) How long to wait before re-sending a notification. By default, it is 4h.

### Nested Schema for `matchers`

Required:

- `match_name` (String) Name of the matcher field (e.g., severity, service).
- `match_value` (String) Value to match against.
- `match_type` (String) Type of match to perform (e.g., equals, regex).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the route policy.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the route policy.
- `created_by` (String) Creator of the route policy.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the route policy.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater of the route policy.
